segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: Hello, Wayside Camera Club, Breda speaking.

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Oh, hello, um, my name’s Dan and I’d like to join your club.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: That’s great, Dan. We have an application form- would you like to complete it over the phone, then you can ask any questions you might have?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Oh, yes, thanks.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: OK, so what’s your family name?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: It’s Green- Dan Green.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: So – can I take your email address?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Yes, it’s dan1068@market.com.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: Thanks. And what about your home address?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Well, I’m about ten miles away from your club in Peacetown. I live in a house there.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: OK, so what’s the house number and street?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: It’s 52 Marrowfield Street.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: Is that M-A double R-O-W-F-l-E-L-D?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: That’s right.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: ... and that’s Peacetown, you said?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Uhuh. ——

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: So how did you hear about our club? Did you look on the internet?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: I usually do that, but this time, well, I was talking to a relative the other day and he suggested it.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: Oh, is he a member too?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: He belongs to another club – but he’d heard good things about yours.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: OK. So what do you hope to get from joining?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Well, one thing that really interests me is the competitions that you have. I enjoy entering those.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: Right. Anything else?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Well, I also like to socialise with other photographers.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: That’s great. So what type of membership would you like?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: What are the options?

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: It’s £30 a year for full membership or £20 a year if you’re an associate.

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: I think I’ll go for the full membership, then.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: That’s a good idea because you can’t vote in meetings with an associate membership. ——

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: If I could just find out a bit more about you ...

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: OK.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: So you said you wanted to compete- have you ever won any photography competitions?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Not yet, but I have entered three in the past.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: Oh, that’s interesting. So why don’t you tell me something about those? Let’s start with the first one.

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Well, the theme was entitled ‘Domestic Life’.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: I see – so it had to be something related to the home?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Yeah. I chose to take a photo of a family sitting round the dinner table having a meal, and, urn, I didn’t win, but I did get some feedback.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: Oh, what did the judges say?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: That it was too ‘busy’ as a picture.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: Aha – so it was the composition of the picture that they criticised?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: That’s right – and once they’d told me that, I could see my mistake.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: So what was the theme of the second competition?

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Well, my university was on the coast and that area gets a lot of beautiful sunsets so that was the theme.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: Oh, sunsets, that’s a great theme.

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Yes. The instructions were to capture the clouds as well – it couldn’t just be blue sky and a setting sun.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: Sure, cause they give you all those amazing pinks and purples.

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Yeah – and I thought I’d done that well, but the feedback was that I should have waited a bit longer to get the shot.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: I see. So the timing wasn’t right.

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Yes – I took it too soon, basically. And then the third competition I entered was called ‘Animal Magic’.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: Well, that’s a difficult subject!

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: I know! I had to take hundreds of shots.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: I’m sure – because animals move all the time.

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: That’s what we had to show – there had to be some movement in the scene. I got a great shot of a fox in the end, but I took it at night and, well, I suspected that it was a bit dark, which is what I was told.

segments.speaker: BREDA
segments.en: Well Dan – you seem to be really keen and we’d be delighted to have you in our club. I’m sure we can help with all those areas that you’ve outlined.

segments.speaker: DAN
segments.en: Thanks, that’s great.
